_comment: Search partitions for Morgan and Peace silver dollars.
Deliberately leaner than the sovereign set. Four partitions against four
price bands is sixteen searches an hour; the sovereign side runs twenty.
That roughly doubles the Browse spend, which at ~900 calls a day against
a 5,000 limit is affordable - but it is the reason the bands are four
Both designs get their own partition rather than one search for 'silver
dollar'. The broad phrase pulls in Eisenhowers, Seated Liberties, Trade
dollars and every modern commemorative, all of which this series would
then have to reject one at a time - and each rejection costs a stored
listing and a row in the review queue. Naming the design is the cheapest
filter available and it happens before eBay bills for the call.
categoryIds stays EMPTY for the same reason it does on the sovereign
side: every allow-list built there proved too narrow, and filtering on
the category ANCESTRY of what comes back is both safer and visible.
_bands: A common circulated dollar runs GBP 25-60, a slabbed one GBP 60-500, and
the key dates go from there into four figures. The bottom band starts at
10 rather than 0 because below it is almost entirely replicas and
novelty pieces, which cost a call to fetch and a click to reject.
